The wardrobe is between the desk and the bed. There is a computer, ten books and five pens on her desk. There are some pictures of her family on the wall. She loves this room so much, so she cleans it regularly.

sections.title: II. Read the following passage and choose the best answer A, B, C, or D for each blank (1.0 points)
sections.introHtml:
Hi Marry,

How are you? I live in Ho Chi Minh City with my parents. We live in a house on Hung Vuong Street. My house (26) ______________ three bedrooms and a small garden.

I live (27) ______________my school so I walk to school every day. I like my school and my favorite subjects are Math and Science. My best friends are Nam and Quan and we are in the (28) ______class. After school I often go to the school canteen with my friends. We usually go (29) _____________and do our homework. I like playing sports very much, so I usually play sports with my friends at the weekend. We play football and basketball and sometimes we go swimming.

Write soon and tell me about yourself, your friends and your family.

Best wishes,

Lan
